name: MathModelAgent
description: 🤖📐专为数学建模设计的 Agent & skills ,自动完成数学建模，生成一份完整的可以直接提交的论文。 An Agent Designed for Mathematical Modeling ,Automatically complete mathmodel and generate a complete paper ready for submission.
one_liner: An AI agent that does mathematical modeling competition work for you — it takes a problem statement and produces a full, submission-ready paper.
buyer: A student or small team preparing for math-modeling competitions (like China's national contests) who needs help structuring and writing up a full paper under time pressure.
business_use_cases: A tutoring center offers 'math modeling competition prep' packages built around the tool, guiding students through practice problems with AI-assisted write-ups.
A university math department's student club uses it to run internal practice sessions ahead of national competitions.
An education content creator builds paid courses teaching modeling methodology, using the tool to demonstrate full worked examples quickly.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a premium hosted version with faster models and more practice problem sets to competition-prep students.
Partner with tutoring centers to license it as part of a paid exam-prep bundle.

steal_this: Package it as a paid 'weekend crash course' for a local math-modeling competition team, using it to generate and critique practice papers.
